name: Follow suggestions
summary: "People you may know" as a sideways row of cards, each with the person's photo, name and handle, the mutual friends behind the suggestion, a follow button that turns into Following, and a way to remove the card.
use: in a social feed or after sign-up, for finding people to follow
a11y: Follow buttons are toggles with aria-pressed and the person's name; removing a card says so in a polite live region and moves focus to the next card's remove button.

use_when: a community or creator app suggesting accounts, groups or creators to follow, with a reason for each
avoid_when: a full list of people to manage or search: use member-list
inviting teammates by email to a workspace: use invite-members
one person's own profile: use profile-card

parts.name: see_all
parts.what: link-style button to the full list

parts.name: cards
parts.what: one suggested person: remove button, photo, name, handle, reason and follow button

parts.name: name
parts.what: the person's name, on one line

parts.name: reason
parts.what: why they are suggested, with up to two small mutual-friend photos

parts.name: follow
parts.what: toggle that reads Follow, Follow back or Following

parts.name: remove
parts.what: removes the card from the row

parts.name: done
parts.what: the line shown once every card is removed

empty.how: when the last card is removed the row hides and a caught-up line shows

loading.how: show three or four cards with a muted circle for the photo and muted bars for the name and button

error.how: if a follow fails, set the button back to Follow and announce the failure in the live region, or show a toast-stack message

disabled.how: while a follow request is pending, set disabled on that card's follow button

overflow.how: the cards scroll sideways in their own row, with snap points and a fade at the right edge

long_text.how: long names and handles are cut with an ellipsis on one line; the reason wraps

keyboard: Tab moves through See all, then each card's remove button and follow button
Enter or Space on a follow button switches it between Follow and Following
Enter or Space on a remove button removes the card, announces it and moves focus to the next card's remove button
